chapter: Baton Rouge, marriage, learning to play
title: Band at the time of Jeff Junior's birth
summary: Names the band he was in around 1938 with Dutch Andrus, Steve Massico and Steve Boudreau.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: And then, who were you playing with when Jeff was born? I'm just trying to set up some dates in my mind if you can remember.

Dutch Andrus. Steve Massico. Sherwood Man Japan. Me on piano. Al Moore on trombone. And Steve Boudreau on drums. Just learned of his death not too long ago. In Baker, Oregon. Steve Boudreau. I taught him how to play drums. He had the natural gift and I just taught him how to keep time and from there he went on by himself. And they are the jazz players that really play the swing. They're the natural gifted ones.
